title: Baked Kibbeh
subtitle: Lebanese lamb and bulgur wheat bake with spiced filling
excerpt: A classic Levantine dish of two layers of spiced lamb and bulgur wheat with a richly seasoned filling of lamb mince and toasted pine nuts between them. Baked until golden and cut into diamond shapes to serve.
sourceNotes: Kibbeh is considered the national dish of Lebanon and Syria. The baked tray version, kibbeh bel-saniyeh, is made for family gatherings and celebrations. Recipes vary by region but the bulgur and lamb base is consistent.

recipe.makeAheadNotes: Assemble the dish up to 4 hours ahead and refrigerate. Add 5 minutes to the baking time.

content.text: The bulgur casing must be very smooth. Process the outer mixture thoroughly in a food processor if you have one, or knead it by hand with wet hands for 5 minutes. A rough mixture will crack during baking.

items.prepNote: soaked in cold water for 20 minutes, then squeezed dry
1 finely grated for casing, 1 finely diced for filling

content.text: Soak the bulgur wheat in cold water for 20 minutes. Drain and squeeze out as much water as possible.
Make the casing. Combine the bulgur, 400g of the lamb mince, the grated onion, and half the spices. Knead until smooth. Season with salt.
Make the filling. Heat the olive oil in a frying pan. Cook the diced onion for 5 minutes.
Add the remaining 200g of lamb mince. Cook for 5 minutes until browned.
Stir in the pine nuts and remaining spices. Season. Remove from the heat.
Oil a deep baking tray (about 30 x 20cm). Press half the casing mixture evenly across the base.
Spread the filling evenly over the base layer.
Press the remaining casing mixture over the top to cover the filling completely.
Score the top into diamond shapes with a sharp knife. Brush with the melted butter.
Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until golden on top. Rest for 5 minutes before cutting.

items.symptom: Top layer cracked and split during baking.
items.cause: The casing mixture was too dry or not pressed down firmly enough.
items.fix: Knead with wet hands and press firmly into the tray.

items.symptom: Filling leaked out at the edges.
items.cause: The top layer did not cover the filling all the way to the sides.
items.fix: Press the top layer right to the edges and seal with wet fingers.
